nights.title: beabadoobee: The Powerlines Tour
nights.name: Beabadoobee
nights.extract: Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, known professionally as Beabadoobee, is a Filipino and British singer and songwriter. From 2018 to 2021, she released five extended plays (EPs) under the independent label Dirty Hit: Lice (2018), Patched Up (2018), Loveworm (2019), Space Cadet (2019) and Our Extended Play (2021). Her debut studio album Fake It Flowers was released in October 2020, and received critical acclaim. Her second studio album, Beatopia, was released on July 2022, and spawned the hit "The Perfect Pair". en.who: Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, known professionally as Beabadoobee, is a Filipino and British singer and songwriter. From 2018 to 2021, she released five extended plays (EPs) under the independent label Dirty Hit.
facts: Her debut studio album Fake It Flowers was released in October 2020, and received critical acclaim.
Her third studio album, This Is How Tomorrow Moves, was released in August 2024; it became her first album to peak atop the UK Albums Chart.

de.who: Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, unter dem Künstlernamen Beabadoobee bekannt, ist eine philippinisch-britische Sängerin und Songwriterin. Von 2018 bis 2021 veröffentlichte sie fünf Extended Plays beim unabhängigen Label Dirty Hit.
facts: Ihr Debütalbum Fake It Flowers erschien im Oktober 2020 und wurde von der Kritik gefeiert.
Ihr drittes Studioalbum This Is How Tomorrow Moves erschien im August 2024; es war ihr erstes Album, das an der Spitze der britischen Albumcharts stand.

tr.who: Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, sahne adıyla Beabadoobee, Filipinli ve İngiliz bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. 2018 ile 2021 arasında bağımsız Dirty Hit etiketiyle beş EP yayımladı.
facts: Debüt stüdyo albümü Fake It Flowers Ekim 2020'de yayımlandı ve büyük beğeni topladı.
Üçüncü stüdyo albümü This Is How Tomorrow Moves Ağustos 2024'te yayımlandı; bu, İngiltere Albüm Listesi'nin zirvesine çıkan ilk albümü oldu.

nights.title: Loreena McKennitt: The Mask and Mirror - 30th Anniversary Tour
nights.name: Loreena McKennitt
nights.extract: Loreena McKennitt is a Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and composer who writes, records, and performs world music with Celtic and Middle Eastern influences. McKennitt is known for her refined and clear soprano vocals. She has sold more than 16 million records worldwide.

en.who: Loreena McKennitt is a Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and composer. She writes, records, and performs world music with Celtic and Middle Eastern influences.

de.who: Loreena McKennitt ist eine kanadische Singer-Songwriterin, Multiinstrumentalistin und Komponistin. Sie schreibt, nimmt auf und präsentiert Weltmusik mit keltischen und nahöstlichen Einflüssen.
facts: McKennitt ist für ihre verfeinerte und klare Sopranstimme bekannt.
Sie hat weltweit mehr als 16 Millionen Tonträger verkauft.

tr.who: Loreena McKennitt, Kanadalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı, çok enstrümanlı müzisyen ve bestecidir. Kelt ve Orta Doğu etkileri taşıyan dünya müziğini yazar, kaydeder ve icra eder.
facts: McKennitt, rafine ve berrak soprano sesiyle tanınır.
Dünya genelinde 16 milyondan fazla plak sattı.

nights.title: Jorja Smith - 10 Years of Jorja Smith
nights.name: Jorja Smith
nights.extract: Jorja Alice Smith is an English singer and songwriter. Born and raised in Walsall, West Midlands, she has been writing songs since the age of 11. In 2012, Smith's friend uploaded her cover of Labrinth's "Earthquake" to YouTube, which led to her discovery by record producer Guy Moot. After her first two singles received broader recognition, she signed with Sony/ATV in early 2016, releasing two EPs throughout later that year and into 2017.

en.who: Jorja Alice Smith is an English singer and songwriter. Born and raised in Walsall, West Midlands, she has been writing songs since the age of 11.
facts: In 2012, Smith's friend uploaded her cover of Labrinth's "Earthquake" to YouTube, which led to her discovery by record producer Guy Moot.

de.who: Jorja Alice Smith ist eine englische Sängerin und Songwriterin. In Walsall in den West Midlands geboren und aufgewachsen, schreibt sie seit ihrem elften Lebensjahr Songs.
facts: Im Jahr 2012 lud eine Freundin ihr Cover von Labrinths "Earthquake" auf YouTube hoch, was zu ihrer Entdeckung durch den Produzenten Guy Moot führte.
Nachdem ihre ersten zwei Singles größere Aufmerksamkeit erhalten hatten, unterschrieb sie Anfang 2016 bei Sony/ATV und veröffentlichte im selben Jahr sowie bis 2017 zwei EPs.

tr.kicker: ingiliz şarkıcı ve söz yazarı · düsseldorf
tr.who: Jorja Alice Smith, İngiliz bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. West Midlands'in Walsall kentinde doğup büyüdü ve 11 yaşından beri şarkı yazıyor.
facts: 2012'de bir arkadaşı, Labrinth'in "Earthquake" parçasındaki cover'ını YouTube'a yükledi; bu da yapımcı Guy Moot'un onu keşfetmesini sağladı.
İlk iki single'ı daha geniş ilgi görünce 2016'nın başında Sony/ATV ile anlaşma imzaladı ve o yıl ile 2017'ye kadar uzanan süreçte iki EP yayımladı.

nights.title: Rod Stewart - "The Final Encore"
nights.name: Rod Stewart
nights.extract: Sir Roderick David Stewart is a British singer and songwriter. Known for his distinctive raspy singing voice, Stewart is among the best-selling music artists of all time, having sold more than 120 million records worldwide. His music career began in 1962 when he took up busking with a harmonica. He was a member of various bands before joining the Jeff Beck Group in 1967. Joining Faces in 1969, he also launched a solo career, releasing his debut album, An Old Raincoat Won't Ever Let You Down, that year. en.who: Sir Roderick David Stewart is a British singer and songwriter. Known for his distinctive raspy singing voice, Stewart is among the best-selling music artists of all time.
facts: His third album, 1971's Every Picture Tells a Story, was his breakthrough, topping the charts in the UK, US, Canada and Australia, as did its single "Maggie May".
His music career began in 1962 when he took up busking with a harmonica.

de.who: Sir Roderick David Stewart ist ein britischer Sänger und Songwriter. Bekannt ist er für seine markante, raue Stimme; Stewart zählt zu den meistverkauften Musikern aller Zeiten.
facts: Sein drittes Album, Every Picture Tells a Story aus dem Jahr 1971, war sein Durchbruch: Es erreichte in Großbritannien, den USA, Kanada und Australien die Chartspitze, ebenso wie die Single "Maggie May".
Seine Musikkarriere begann 1962, als er mit einer Mundharmonika auf der Straße musizierte.

tr.kicker: ingiliz şarkıcı ve söz yazarı · düsseldorf
tr.who: Sir Roderick David Stewart, İngiliz bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Kısık ve kendine özgü sesiyle tanınır; tüm zamanların en çok satan müzisyenleri arasındadır.
facts: Üçüncü albümü 1971 tarihli Every Picture Tells a Story atılımı oldu; albüm ve "Maggie May" single'ı İngiltere, ABD, Kanada ve Avustralya listelerinin zirvesine çıktı.
Müzik kariyeri 1962'de, bir mızıkayla sokakta çalmaya başladığında başladı.

nights.title: KAROL G - VIAJANDO POR EL MUNDO TROPITOUR
nights.name: Karol G
nights.extract: Carolina Giraldo Navarro, known professionally as Karol G, is a Colombian singer-songwriter. She is considered one of the most influential reggaeton and urban pop artists. Her accolades include a Grammy Award, eight Latin Grammy Awards and five Billboard Music Awards. She was recognised as Woman of the Year and received the Rulebreaker Award at the Billboard Women in Music Awards 2024 ceremony, and has also achieved eleven Guinness World Records.

de.who: Carolina Giraldo Navarro, unter dem Künstlernamen Karol G bekannt, ist eine kolumbianische Singer-Songwriterin. Sie gilt als eine der einflussreichsten Künstlerinnen des Reggaeton und des urbanen Pop.
facts: Zu ihren Auszeichnungen gehören ein Grammy, acht Latin Grammys und fünf Billboard Music Awards.
Außerdem hat sie elf Guinness-Weltrekorde erreicht.

tr.who: Carolina Giraldo Navarro, sahne adıyla Karol G, Kolombiyalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. En etkili reggaeton ve urban pop sanatçılarından biri olarak kabul edilir.
facts: Ödülleri arasında bir Grammy, sekiz Latin Grammy ve beş Billboard Music Awards bulunur.
Ayrıca on bir Guinness Dünya Rekoru elde etmiştir.
